items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: We played Palisades Park... I was playing piano with gloves on, so was Joe.

ctx.x: Joe Venuti? Some really marvelous — not only musicians but characters.
Joe Venuti himself was a character. Unbelievable. I was telling a story just the other day about Joe Venuti. We played Palisades Park. Do you remember that name at all?
